decisions.reason: Its downgrade from a dedicated page in 2023 to a simple mention in 2024 suggests results fell somewhat below aspirations, but continued listing implies enough demand or slack to keep it under review rather than drop it immediately.

Being mentioned in both 2023 and 2024 indicates stable if unspectacular acceptance, which for a medium established textile firm is usually enough to remain in the assortment while management watches performance.
A dedicated page in both years signals that this product is meeting or exceeding aspirations relative to the rest of the launch cohort, so withdrawal within a year is unlikely.

The product stayed on the website across both years but never gained stronger prominence, pointing to middling performance that is below standout status yet still acceptable within the firm's portfolio.

Its continued but low-profile presence suggests uncertain or niche results, so management would likely retain it for now because the shortfall is not clear enough to force resource reallocation immediately.
As a 2024 launch with its own page, it appears to have strong initial backing and is still too new for a boundedly rational firm to abandon unless early results become clearly disappointing.
